notes: Cats: the Régionale bank's Beer (56 stems, ingredients, malting, mashing, the boil, styles, the spec sheet, service and pairing) and the Village bank's Beer & Cider (20 stems, 14 on beer and 6 on cider and perry). Chapters: the Régionale beer chapter (the four ingredients, ale against lager, the spec sheet and the glass) and the Village Beer & Cider chapter (yeast species, style families by country, Trappist and lambic, cider). No region article, country record, grape or technique teaches beer, so none is mapped; the Beerenauslese hits in the German and Austrian articles are wine. Service tables: glassware (the beer glasses row: pilsner, Belgian tulip or goblet, nonic pint) and temperatures (the beer row, lager 4 to 7 C, ales 8 to 12 C, stout and cask 10 to 13 C). Two beer stems sit outside the map in Service & Hospitality, c-m36084ry (the beer clean glass) and c-bj2f7v48 (FIFO), and are cited in the review rather than mapped, since that cat holds 64 stems almost all on wine.
